name: Recurrent Corrective Atlas

basis.U: top32 left singular vectors of 1024x128 fit oracle matrix, uncentered, fixed afterward
basis.claim: empirical source intervention basis, not anatomical causal basis

observer.dictionary_columns: raw columns divided by max(norm,1e-6); trainable during source fit, frozen target

correction.optimality_claim: 5 finite iterations, not exact sparse optimum; recurrence bound not a full segmentation guarantee

calibration.observation_equivalent: scale residual energy by 1/kappa^2 in correction; eta recomputed accordingly; do not change lambda/mu
calibration.fit: source-cal latent MSE after5 steps; only kappa updated

static: reset zprev=0 and dprev=current d before each visit; separately source train
main_ablation: B_PRED_ONLY: delta=0, preserve full recurrent prediction; same full checkpoint, not independently optimized
falsifiers: 5step correction does not improve source-heldout or target over predictor-only
iterative objective decreases but segmentation degrades
temporal model fails against budget-matched STATIC
